author: toketrain
body:
in my opinion, the way the badges are placed next to the name looks a bit odd. there's no space between the name and the badge. i mentioned this in a game yesterday and a couple people liked it, so here's the official suggestion. 
(since i don't have a rank, i'm just gonna pretend "user" shows up)
it'd look like

USER | ♥ | tribblei: hello

it just makes the badge look a bit more special. formatting it like it is now was good for the prestige star, but for a bigger symbol it looks better in the above format.
